propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket handwritten signatures omit force, reason, caused_by, and ref parameters already supported by the library and CLI, making them unreachable over MCP because FastMCP drops undeclared payload keys before the callable runs.
The MCP adapter forwarding layer independently forwards only close_class or assignee and omits the same parameters, so signature changes alone are insufficient to expose them.
Live MCP tool invocations with cause_by and ref values fail to persist the edge or target the requested commit respectively, while equivalent library calls succeed.
The 2026-08-18 operator ruling rescinds the CLI/library-only force policy and establishes total parity across all surfaces with absent certification as the audit signal.

MCP transition_ticket force must support both start-work and completion-close bypass semantics using a single reason-bearing force parameter unified with claim_ticket, and force_close must remain unavailable.
